description: Two shared scoped terms with the same numerical code are equal.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.term_code_injective.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (S : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.EffectiveSignature L) {n : ℕ} :
  Function.Injective
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.termCode S
      (Sum.elim Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.freeName fun i =>
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.boundName ↑i))
